title: Saints to have joint practices with Jaguars, Cowboys, Rams this summer

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Saints to have joint practices with Jaguars, Cowboys, Rams this summer
sources.description: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said in March that the team will be holding training camp in Louisiana this summer, but they will head to California for some extended work as well.
